doc: Everything the animator needs for one frame: the skeleton, the local wind, the time, and the break.

fields.name: wind_speed
fields.doc: Wind speed at the tree, m/s.

fields.name: wind_heading
fields.doc: Direction the wind blows toward, degrees from +Z toward +X.

fields.name: break_time
fields.doc: Seconds since the tree broke; negative while it stands.

fields.name: break_heading
fields.doc: Direction the tree falls toward, degrees from +Z toward +X.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Stable randomness for this instance's sway phase and debris.
